Our MARQUEe clientele

Over the years, Kriti Industries (India) Limited has created a unique presence in the pipes sector and gained
several marquee and repeat customers and partners. We cater to various clients because of their belief in
our extensive product portfolio within an affordable varied price ranges and responsive customer service.

Awards and accolades

At Kasta Pipes, our quality has been consistently celebrated.
The brand and company have won awards for product quality from credible national agencies.
This has validated the company’s respect as a forward-looking manufacturer.

Indore Gaurav Samman, 2022
JITO “GAURAV”, 2022

by ET Edge
